description: Defense/Special Teams historical fantasy performance (weeks 10-18 of 2025 season). Includes rolling averages and week-over-week trends. ML projections coming in Phase 2.

columns.name: team
columns.allowed_values: 32 NFL teams (ARI, ATL, BAL, BUF, CAR, CHI, CIN, CLE, DAL, DEN, DET, GB, HOU, IND, JAX, KC, LV, LAC, LAR, MIA, MIN, NE, NO, NYG, NYJ, PHI, PIT, SF, SEA, TB, TEN, WAS)

columns.name: week
columns.description: NFL week number (10-18 for this dataset)

columns.name: fantasy_points
columns.description: Fantasy points scored by defense/ST in this week
columns.notes: Higher points = better performance (sacks, INTs, fumbles, TDs, low points allowed)

columns.name: week_rank
columns.description: Ranking within that week (1 = best defense that week)
columns.notes: Use this to identify top streaming options for a specific week

columns.name: avg_last_4_weeks
columns.description: Rolling 4-week average of fantasy points (including current week)
columns.notes: PRIMARY SORTING METRIC - Shows consistent performance, not one-week flukes

columns.name: pts_change_from_last_week
columns.description: Point differential from previous week (positive = improvement, negative = decline)
columns.notes: NULL for week 10 (first week in dataset). Use for trend analysis.

validation_rules: team must be valid NFL abbreviation
avg_last_4_weeks calculated as trailing 4-week rolling average
known_limitations: Sleeper scoring only (may differ from other platforms)

r2_access.method: Authenticated S3 API (boto3) or Backend Proxy

metadata.note: Historical performance only. ML projections coming soon.

sorting.for_streaming: Filter to latest week, sort by week_rank ASC

filtering.by_week: Filter to specific week for historical analysis

display_recommendations: Show avg_last_4_weeks as primary metric (e.g., '15.8 avg pts')
Display pts_change_from_last_week with trend icons: '↑6 pts' or '↓2 pts'
Show week_rank as badge for latest week (e.g., '#1 DEF Week 18')
Color-code by avg_last_4_weeks: Green (>=12), Yellow (8-12), Gray (<8)
Add 'Top Streamer' badge for week_rank <= 5 in latest week
Show sparkline chart of last 4 weeks' fantasy_points for visual trend

use_cases.defense_streaming: Filter to latest week, sort by week_rank, show top 10
use_cases.season_long_value: Sort by avg_last_4_weeks DESC, show consistent performers
use_cases.matchup_analysis: Group by week, compare defenses playing each other
use_cases.trend_spotting: Sort by pts_change_from_last_week DESC, find hot defenses

sample_data.interpretation: ELITE - Top-ranked defense in Week 18 with elite 4-week average (19 pts). Trending up strongly (+6 from Week 17).
STRONG - Consistent performer with 13.8 avg. Slight dip this week but still top 10.
SOLID - Good 4-week average (13 pts) with strong Week 18 bounce-back (+6).

features: Historical defense data export to R2
Projected fantasy points for upcoming week
required_work: Build defense feature engineering (team stats, opponent stats, home/away)
